data.exact_reserve_text: Claims incurred during the year, net of reinsurance, included positive prior year development of GBP 3.3m (2021: GBP 39.7m) on the net claims reserves that existed at the end of the prior financial year.

prior_year_events.event_name: RITC of Syndicate 5678's open years of account
prior_year_events.impact_description: The RITC of Syndicate 5678's open years of account into Syndicate 1110 significantly increased gross technical reserves and total liabilities, distorting claims development figures.
The ADC of certain years of account of Syndicates 33 and 3624 significantly increased gross technical reserves and total liabilities.

prior_year_events.event_name: RITC of 2019 and 2020 years of account
prior_year_events.impact_description: The 2019 and 2020 years of account have reinsured into the 2022 year of account, indicating closure and finalisation of results for these prior years.

prior_year_events.event_name: Uncertainty regarding reinsurance balances with Co/Action Specialty Group
prior_year_events.impact_description: The 2017 YOA of Syndicate 1110 has not been able to close at 72 months due to continuing uncertainty regarding reinsurance balances with Co/Action Specialty Group, the major reinsurer of its liabilities.

named_events.event_name: RITC of Syndicate 5678's open years of account
named_events.loss_description: Syndicate entered into RITC of all Syndicate 5678's open years of account, part of R&Q Group strategy to consolidate Lloyd's platform into one syndicate.
Syndicate entered into ADC of certain years of account of Syndicates 33 and 3624, managed by Hiscox Syndicates Limited.
Funds withheld 80% whole account quota share reinsurance agreement on certain contracts with Gibson Re Ltd, applying to Syndicate 5678 RITC and Hiscox ADC.
Continuing uncertainty regarding reinsurance balances with Co/Action Specialty Group, major reinsurer of 2017 YOA liabilities, preventing closure at 72 months.

data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate experienced positive prior year development of GBP 3.3m on a net basis, indicating a strengthening of net claims reserves. This was primarily driven by claims inflation and deterioration in the casualty business. The gross prior year development could not be reliably determined due to significant distortions from Reinsurance to Close (RITC) transactions involving Syndicate 5678 and the 2019 and 2020 years of account, as well as an Adverse Development Cover (ADC) transaction.

gross_premium_mix.line_of_business: Fire and other damage to property

data.data_quality_notes: The gross prior year development could not be reliably extracted. While a net prior year development of GBP 3.3m (strengthening) is stated in the narrative, the claims development table is significantly distorted by Reinsurance to Close (RITC) transactions (Syndicate 5678, 2019 and 2020 years of account) and an Adverse Development Cover (ADC) transaction, making it unsuitable for calculating gross prior year development via diagonal comparison. The prompt explicitly forbids using net figures for prior_year_development_gbp_m.
